blurb: Dream Dance Academy offers a variety of dance classes from September to June including Ballet, Pointe, Jazz, Tap, Lyrical, Contemporary, Technique, Musical Theater, Modern, Leaps & Turns, and Hip-Hop. Children are placed in classes based on talent, skills, and experience, not just age. The academy holds an annual recital in June to showcase students' progress.
extraNote: Registration, competition, and costume fees are non-refundable · Tuition is due by the 1st of every month and is non-refundable · $25 late fee if tuition paid after 10th of the month · Withdrawal requires two weeks notice and a withdrawal form · September through June
